tips.title: Separate at the source
tips.body: Keep three containers at home: dry recyclables, organic food waste, and residual waste. Sorting at the point of use is the single biggest boost to recycling rates in Yola.

tips.title: Never burn nylon or plastic
tips.body: Open burning of sachets and plastics releases dioxins that irritate lungs and worsen harmattan haze. Bundle nylon and take it to a buy-back hub instead.

tips.title: Harvest rainwater in the wet season
tips.body: A 100 m² roof can capture over 8,000 litres from a single 100 mm rain event. Use clean covered barrels and screen the inlet against mosquitoes.

tips.title: Right-size your generator use
tips.body: Run heavy appliances together in one generator window rather than many short starts. Short cycles waste fuel and increase emissions per kWh.

tips.title: Switch to LED and solar lanterns
tips.body: LEDs use up to 85% less power than incandescent bulbs, so your inverter or solar bank lasts far longer per charge.

tips.title: Cook with better stoves
tips.body: Improved cookstoves and LPG cut indoor smoke dramatically compared with three-stone firewood fires — a major cause of respiratory illness.

tips.title: Mask up on dusty harmattan days
tips.body: When PM10 climbs above 150 µg/m³, a simple well-fitted mask meaningfully reduces the dust you inhale on okada and open-market trips.

tips.title: Compost your kitchen scraps
tips.body: Food waste is roughly half of typical household waste. Composting it turns a disposal cost into free fertiliser for your garden.

tips.title: Keep waste out of drainage channels
tips.body: Blocked drains are the leading cause of flash flooding in Jimeta. Report blocked channels through EcoInfo so crews can clear them before the rains peak.

tips.title: Organise a monthly street clean-up
tips.body: Neighbourhood clean-ups clear hotspots faster than any agency can. Log yours on EcoInfo to earn community points and track progress.

tips.title: Combine trips and share rides
tips.body: Two combined trips instead of four halves your fuel spend and tailpipe emissions — and reduces traffic dust on unpaved roads.

tips.title: Plant shade trees on your compound
tips.body: Neem, mango and moringa cool the air around buildings by several degrees, cut dust and stabilise soil against erosion.

tips.title: Refill instead of re-buying
tips.body: Buy larger refills of soap, oil and detergent and decant into reused containers. Less packaging waste and lower cost per litre.

tips.title: Report illegal dumping early
tips.body: Fresh dumps are cheap to clear; established ones attract more waste and become permanent. Report within the first days with a photo and location.
